description: This file defines a utility object 'Converters' providing Room database type converters for the Date type, enabling conversion between Date objects and Long timestamps for database storage.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A singleton object containing Room type converters for Date.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Long timestamp to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Date object to a Long timestamp.
